name: GRP La volta a Andorra
description_md:
The GRP La volta a Andorra is a 110.9 km waymarked hiking route in AD that starts and finishes at the same place. It is part of a regional waymarked hiking network and is signposted as GRP.

The route includes 8410 m of ascent and 8410 m of descent. The walking time is about 59 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. Its difficulty is easy, derived from distance and ascent. Additionally, the route passes Madriu-Perafita-Claror Valley within 1600 m.
